scripts/inspect_reversal_debug.py

Small utility to inspect reversal debug CSVs and (optionally) merge with accepted reversal timestamps.

Usage examples (from project root):

# Show top 20 debug rows (sorted by ms_aggr desc):
python -u scripts/inspect_reversal_debug.py

# Show top 20 debug rows from a specific debug CSV:
python -u scripts/inspect_reversal_debug.py --debug out/labels_v02/reversal_debug.csv

# Merge accepted reversals from labels-only file (labels_only_v02_*.csv) and show merged top 20:
python -u scripts/inspect_reversal_debug.py --labels out/labels_v02/labels_only_v02_20251128_151519.csv

# Merge and print merged rows:
python -u scripts/inspect_reversal_debug.py --debug out/labels_v02/reversal_debug.csv --labels out/labels_v02/labels_only_v02_20251128_151519.csv

docstring:
scripts/label_quality_report.py

Generate a label-quality report for train/val/test CSVs produced by
scripts/prepare_labels_dataset.py.

Outputs:
 - console summary
 - markdown report -> outputs/label_quality_report.md
 - simple PNG plots -> outputs/figs/*.png

Usage (examples):
  python scripts/label_quality_report.py --csvs data/train.csv data/val.csv data/test.csv
  python scripts/label_quality_report.py --data-dir data/ --out-dir outputs/

Dependencies:
  pandas, numpy, matplotlib

This script is defensive: it will not modify your CSVs.

docstring:
scripts/prepare_labels_dataset.py

Prepare labeled dataset for Project_PhantomScalp v0.2:
 - loads an optional spot CSV of OHLCV (expects datetime column or index)
 - otherwise generates a full synthetic OHLCV timeseries (open/high/low/close/volume)
 - computes features via app.features.time_cycle, microstructure, options_features (defensive)
 - runs labelers (regime, reversal, cycle) from app.ml.labels (defensive)
 - writes train/val/test splits (parquet + csv) and labels-only CSV and meta JSON

Key points:
 - defensive: never raises on missing feature columns; labelers receive sensible fallbacks
 - timezone-safe: produce tz-aware UTC index by default
 - avoids deprecated pandas patterns (uses .ffill()/.bfill(), pct_change(fill_method=None))
 - creates timestamped outputs in the target directory

Scan & optionally fix pandas deprecation patterns:
 - fillna(method='ffill'/'bfill')  -> .ffill()/ .bfill()
 - pct_change(... ) without fill_method -> add fill_method=None

Usage:
  # dry-run (report only)
  python scripts/scan_fix_pandas_deprecations.py --report

  # actually apply fixes (will create .bak backups)
  python scripts/scan_fix_pandas_deprecations.py --apply

Notes:
 - Script is conservative: only applies simple textual transforms and creates backups.
 - Review diffs (bak -> original) if you want to revert.

scripts/test_labels.py

Defensive smoke test for labelers with robust feature-module handling.

Changes vs previous:
 - replaced deprecated fillna(method='ffill') / fillna(method='bfill') with .ffill().bfill()
 - replaced datetime.utcnow() with timezone-aware datetime.now(timezone.utc)

Unit tests for app/ml/preprocess.py placed in the scripts/ folder to match your repo layout.

- Tests fit_and_save_pipeline -> load_pipeline -> transform_df_with_pipeline
- Uses synthetic data so tests don't depend on your real dataset.
- Writes artifacts to tmp_path (pytest fixture) to avoid repo pollution.

scripts/train_smoke.py

Tiny "one-epoch" trainer to validate dataset shapes, dtypes and training pipeline.
Trains a single-epoch linear classifier (SGD) on regime_sig using basic features.

Usage:
  PYTHONPATH=. python scripts/train_smoke.py --data out/datasets_v02/labels_dataset_v02_<ts>_train.parquet

If `--data` omitted, defaults to latest CSV in out/datasets_v02 matching *_train.csv

docstring:
scripts/validate_labels_dataset.py

Validator for label datasets (train/val/test) with AUTO-DETECTION.

Features:
- If explicit CSV paths are provided with --csvs, those are used.
- Otherwise the script searches the provided --data-dir (and common subfolders)
  for files matching patterns like '*_train.csv', '*train.csv', etc.
- If multiple candidate triplets exist, the script picks the triplet with the
  newest timestamp (by timestamp in filename if present, else by mtime).
- Output report ALWAYS saved to root-level 'out/' folder (default: out/validate_report.md)

Usage examples:
  # 1) Let the script auto-discover datasets under out/datasets_v02
  python scripts/validate_labels_dataset.py --data-dir out/datasets_v02

  # 2) Auto-discover under the repo and use default out/
  python scripts/validate_labels_dataset.py

  # 3) Provide explicit filenames (relative to data-dir)
  python scripts/validate_labels_dataset.py --data-dir out/datasets_v02       --csvs labels_dataset_v02_20251128_175517_train.csv              labels_dataset_v02_20251128_175517_val.csv              labels_dataset_v02_20251128_175517_test.csv

  # 4) Provide absolute paths
  python scripts/validate_labels_dataset.py --csvs /abs/path/train.csv /abs/path/val.csv /abs/path/test.csv

Outputs:
  - Markdown report saved to root 'out/' directory (default filename validate_report.md)
  - Exit code 0 if no major issues, 2 if suspicious issues found

Author: Generated for Project_PhantomScalp v0.2 → v0.3
